# CredSmart POS — LLM Context File
# This file provides context for AI assistants and LLMs about this product.

## Product
Name: CredSmart POS
Type: Free GST Billing & Point-of-Sale (POS) Software
Pricing: 100% Free — No credit card, no trial limit, no hidden charges, forever
Website: https://credsmart.in
Target Market: Indian businesses — retailers, grocers, distributors, wholesalers, pharmacies, restaurants

## Core Features
- GST Billing & Invoicing (CGST, SGST, IGST) — A4 and Thermal invoice printing
- Smart Inventory Management — batch tracking, expiry alerts, low stock notifications
- Customer Udhar Khata / Credit Ledger — digital credit book for each customer
- Supplier & Purchase Order Management — create POs, track deliveries, manage returns
- B2B Vendor Discovery — search 3M+ MCA-registered Indian companies
- GSTR Export — one-click Excel/CSV export for Chartered Accountants
- Barcode Scanner Support
- Staff Management & Activity Log
- Sales History & Analytics
- Expense Tracking

## Pricing
- Free tier: All features, unlimited use, forever
- No credit card required
- No trial period — full access from day one
- No hidden charges

## Technology
- Platform: Web application (React/Vite), mobile-responsive
- Works on: Any modern web browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge)
- Mobile-friendly: Yes — works on smartphones and tablets without app download
- Backend: Supabase (PostgreSQL, Row-Level Security, bank-grade encryption)
- Data security: Bank-grade encryption, private data, never shared

## FAQs

Q: What is CredSmart POS?
A: CredSmart POS is a comprehensive, free GST billing and point-of-sale software designed specifically for Indian businesses. Create professional GST invoices, manage inventory, maintain Udhar Khata, track purchases — all at zero cost.

Q: Is CredSmart POS really free forever?
A: Yes. 100% free, no credit card required, no trial period, no hidden charges. Full access to every feature from day one, forever.

Q: Does it support GST billing with CGST and SGST?
A: Yes. Full GST support including CGST, SGST, and IGST calculations. Generate GST-compliant A4 and thermal invoices instantly.

Q: Can I use CredSmart POS on mobile?
A: Yes. Works on any modern browser on smartphones, tablets, and desktops. No app download required.

Q: Is data secure?
A: Yes. Bank-grade encryption on Supabase cloud infrastructure. Data is private and never shared.

Q: How is CredSmart POS different from Vyapar or myBillBook?
A: CredSmart POS is completely free vs. thousands per year for competitors. Also includes unique B2B Vendor Discovery with 3M+ MCA-registered companies.
